import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, RandomizedSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import os

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")
ids = sample_sub["id"]

# Define columns to drop to prevent noise and ensure efficient computation
drop_cols = ["id", "target", "f_27"]

# Prepare training features
train_features = train.drop(columns=drop_cols, errors="ignore").copy()
test_features = test.drop(columns=drop_cols, errors="ignore").copy()
train_features = train_features.astype({"f_29": "int", "f_30": "int"})
test_features = test_features.astype({"f_29": "int", "f_30": "int"})

# Create target series for training
y = train["target"].values

# Split training data into Train and Validation sets for hold-out estimation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_features, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Hyperparameter tuning using RandomizedSearchCV
param_distributions = {
    "num_leaves": [31, 50, 64],
    "learning_rate": [0.01, 0.05, 0.1],
    "min_child_samples": [20, 50, 100],
    "n_estimators": [1500, 2000, 2500],
}

random_search = RandomizedSearchCV(
    estimator=LGBMClassifier(objective="binary"),
    param_distributions=param_distributions,
    n_iter=10,
    cv=5,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=4,
)

random_search.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Retrieve best parameters and create final model
best_params = random_search.best_params_
final_model = LGBMClassifier(**best_params)

# Train final model on full training data
final_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
val_predictions = final_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Validation AUROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
test_predictions = final_model.predict_proba(test_features)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": ids, "target": test_predictions})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
